reason: Notify Sarah Okonkwo's patient-facing app of status changes on her teledentistry referral (Task/task-referral-tracking), so the app can surface milestone updates (referral sent, appointment confirmed, and — at Interaction 4 — referral complete) without Sarah needing to call either office.

note.text: Per the HL7 FHIR Subscriptions R4 Backport IG, same pattern established for UC01/UC02/UC03: the SubscriptionTopic canonical URL is carried directly in Subscription.criteria, not via a separate extension. Sarah is an adult subscribing on her own behalf (no guardian/RelatedPerson, unlike UC03's pediatric case). This single Subscription spans the whole UC04a episode. Patient-visible milestones: referral sent (I1) and appointment confirmed (I2); referral complete fires at I4 (not built this pass). Like UC02b, there is NO 'prior authorization approved' milestone — commercial coverage here requires no PA.
